name: Krishna Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Krishna Ventures Ltd is in the business of HVAC, Steel Fabrication, Solar Structure and Pre-Engineered Building[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KVL provides engineering solutions in HVAC, Steel Fabrication, Solar Structures, and Pre-Engineered Buildings. The company manufactures, trades, and rents various air conditioning and refrigeration equipment, including refrigerants, compressors, condensers, heaters, cold storage units, refrigerated trucks, and industrial cooling systems.
